label: TEST: CX-8 rig and local test stack only. Not an owner decision and not a product default.

EMISSIONS_EPOCH_MS.note: TEST epoch length of one second, so a journey can mint one TEST epoch on every run. Unset in production uses the one-day default.

TOKEN_LAUNCH_MIN_KYC_TIER.note: TEST least identity verification to take part in a launch, so a journey can show an unverified account blocked. Blank in production refuses launch.min_kyc_tier_unset.

TOKEN_LAUNCH_RESTRICTED_REGIONS.note: TEST: no region is barred from a launch. Blank in production refuses launch.restricted_regions_unset.

TOKEN_PARAMS_HALVING_INTERVAL.note: TEST token_params.halving_interval, written by `local-test-stack.mjs token-params` into a blank column only. Not an env setting; blank in production refuses token.params_unset.

TOKEN_PARAMS_INITIAL_EPOCH_REWARD.note: TEST token_params.emission_curve.initialEpochReward (IFC per epoch), written by `local-test-stack.mjs token-params` into a blank column only. Blank in production refuses token.params_unset.

TOKEN_PARAMS_TOTAL_SUPPLY.note: TEST token_params.total_supply cap, written by `local-test-stack.mjs token-params` into a blank column only. Blank in production refuses token.params_unset.

TOKEN_PROPOSAL_LIMIT.note: TEST cap of 20 proposals per author per 7 days. Blank in production refuses token.proposal_limit_unset.

TOKEN_PROPOSER_RULE.note: TEST who may open a proposal: at least 1000 of the staking asset. Blank in production refuses token.proposer_rule_unset.
